notes: PAQS-seq: tRNA modification sequencing (periodate treatment, ligation of RNA, gel cut of 20-300 nt inserts), so assay_class other for all E. coli samples. Stresses are 10 min in LB at A600 0.4: DIP (iron chelation) metal_limitation, H2O2 oxidative, alpha-methyl glucoside-6-phosphate other_chemical. Ecoli_minusIO4/plusIO4 and Ecoli_none are untreated (mock) controls. Temperature not stated. rRNA removal not stated.

base_medium.q: E. coli MG1655 cells were grown in LB to a A600 of 0.4

medium_class.q: grown in LB to a A600 of 0.4

amino_acids_supplied.q: grown in LB to a A600 of 0.4

growth_phase.q: RNA was extracted from E. coli MG1655 cells grown in LB until mid-log growth

genotype_class.q: Each culture was split into 4, and subjected to 1 of 3 stresses or a control

global_regulator_perturbed.q: Each culture was split into 4, and subjected to 1 of 3 stresses or a control

inducer_added.q: Each culture was split into 4, and subjected to 1 of 3 stresses or a control

transcription_arrested.q: Each culture was split into 4, and subjected to 1 of 3 stresses or a control

mixed_organism.q: RNA extracted from E. coli cells was used to prepare libraries with and without periodate treatment

assay_class.q: lanes were cut for inserts between 20ng and 300nt

treatment.q: RNA was extracted from E. coli MG1655 cells grown in LB until mid-log growth

is_control.q: Mock treated cells, 25 mL, were left to grow for 10 min

growth_phase.q: grown in LB until mid-log growth then treated

treatment.q: Iron depletion stress was done by adding to 25 mL cells 2,2’-dipyridl (DIP) to 250 µM final concentration for 10 min
Glucose phosphate stress was done by adding to 25 mL cells α-methyl glucoside-6-phosphate (αMG) to a final concentration of 1 mM for 10 min
Hydrogen peroxide stress was done by adding H2O2 to 25 mL cells to a final concentration of 0.5% for 10 min
